name: RAI Amsterdam
description: The RAI exhibition complex opened at Europaplein in 1961. Alexander Bodon’s Europahal and Het Signaal are protected as a national monument. The Westhal followed in 1963 and Amstelhal in 1969; those additions share the present campus but have distinct construction periods. Benthem Crouwel’s Elicium, added in 2009, links the halls above an open ground-level circulation area.
